mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_order_notifications (order_id, provider, provider_transaction_id) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{provider}, #{transactionId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id = order_id
mapper.select: SELECT order_id FROM payment_order_notifications WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, order_id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order_notifications SET status = 'PROCESSING', claim_token = #{token}, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 60, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ( (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, provider, provider_transaction_id, attempts FROM payment_order_notifications WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
